definition: the line leading to a place
description: An open grassy airfield under dark stormy clouds. An orange and white striped windsock on a tall pole stands straight out to the right, blown stiff by a strong wind. A small tree beside it is bent over the same way, the long grass is flattened to the right, and loose leaves fly through the air at first. The view slowly rises from a muddy track with puddles towards the windsock and the moving clouds, with a low barn and trees on the horizon in the evening light.

taps.phrase: to fly from a tall pole
